ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff / Sapphire Sleet fake-recruiter LNK-in-ISO → script host download chain
ucs.description: Hunts Bluenoroff's hallmark Sapphire Sleet / TA444 social-engineering chain against fintech and crypto-exchange staff: a recruiter-themed ISO/IMG/ZIP delivers a weaponised LNK that detonates from a non-C: mount and spawns a Windows script host or LOLBin which curls / msiexec-installs a second-stage payload (KANDYKORN, RustBucket Win port, CageyChameleon, ObjCShellz Win loader).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","7zG.exe","7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe","Bandizip.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","msiexec.exe","curl.exe")) AND (Processes.parent_process LIKE "%.lnk%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%.lnk%" OR match(Processes.process,"(?i)(http[s]?:\/\/|msiexec\s+\/(i|q|quiet)\s+http|curl\s+(-o|--output|-s)\s+http|certutil\s+-(urlcache|decode)|bitsadmin\s+\/transfer|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|wscript\s+.*\.(vbs|js)|rundll32.*,#?[0-9]+)") OR match(Processes.process,"^[D-Z]:\\\\")) AND Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename firstTime as _time | eval JobLureHit=if(match(process,"(?i)(jobdescription|salary|compensation|offer|hr_|recruit|crypto|trading|investor|venture|whitepaper|kucoin|binance|coinbase|defi|nft|web3)"),1,0) | where JobLureHit=1 OR match(parent_process,"(?i)\.iso|\.img|\.vhd|\.vhdx")
ucs.kql:
let LureRegex = @"(?i)(jobdescription|salary|compensation|offer_letter|hr_form|recruit|crypto|trading|investor|venture|whitepaper|kucoin|binance|coinbase|defi|nft|web3|wallet|airdrop)";
let RemoteFetchRegex = @"(?i)(https?://|msiexec\s+/(i|q|quiet)\s+http|curl\s+(-o|--output|-s)\s+http|certutil\s+-(urlcache|decode|f)|bitsadmin\s+/transfer|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|Invoke-Expression|IEX\b|rundll32\s+[^,]+,#?\d+)";
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","bandizip.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","msiexec.exe","curl.exe")
| extend MountedFromRemovable = FolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
| extend LnkLaunch = InitiatingProcessCommandLine has ".lnk" or ProcessCommandLine has ".lnk"
| extend RemoteFetch = ProcessCommandLine matches regex RemoteFetchRegex
| extend LureHit = ProcessCommandLine matches regex LureRegex or InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex LureRegex
| where (MountedFromRemovable and (RemoteFetch or LnkLaunch)) or (LnkLaunch and RemoteFetch) or (LureHit and (RemoteFetch or LnkLaunch))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          MountedFromRemovable, LnkLaunch, RemoteFetch, LureHit, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LureRegex = @"(?i)(jobdescription|salary|compensation|offer_letter|hr_form|recruit|crypto|trading|investor|venture|whitepaper|kucoin|binance|coinbase|defi|nft|web3|wallet|airdrop)";
let RemoteFetchRegex = @"(?i)(https?://|msiexec\s+/(i|q|quiet)\s+http|curl\s+(-o|--output|-s)\s+http|certutil\s+-(urlcache|decode|f)|bitsadmin\s+/transfer|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|Invoke-Expression|IEX\b|rundll32\s+[^,]+,#?\d+)";
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in ("explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","bandizip.exe")
| where ChildName in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","msiexec.exe","curl.exe")
| extend MountedFromRemovable = NewProcessName matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
| extend LnkLaunch = CommandLine has ".lnk"
| extend RemoteFetch = CommandLine matches regex RemoteFetchRegex
| extend LureHit = CommandLine matches regex LureRegex
| where (MountedFromRemovable and (RemoteFetch or LnkLaunch)) or (LnkLaunch and RemoteFetch) or (LureHit and (RemoteFetch or LnkLaunch))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          MountedFromRemovable, LnkLaunch, RemoteFetch, LureHit
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff Sapphire Sleet LNK-in-ISO Recruiter Lure Chain
id: 2f1b9b71-7c0e-4b8b-a0c7-bluenoroff-recruiter-lnk-iso
status: experimental
description: Detects Bluenoroff/Sapphire Sleet/TA444 fake-recruiter delivery chain - archive/ISO mount spawns LNK that launches a script host or LOLBin which fetches a remote second stage.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.002
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.007
  - attack.g0098
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_archive:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\7zG.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\WinRAR.exe'
      - '\Bandizip.exe'
  child_scripthost:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  selection_lnk:
    CommandLine|contains: '.lnk'
  selection_remote_fetch:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - 'msiexec /i http'
      - 'msiexec /q http'
      - 'curl -o http'
      - 'curl --output http'
      - 'certutil -urlcache'
      - 'certutil -decode'
      - 'bitsadmin /transfer'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'IEX'
  selection_lure:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'jobdescription'
      - 'compensation'
      - 'offer_letter'
      - 'recruit'
      - 'whitepaper'
      - 'kucoin'
      - 'binance'
      - 'coinbase'
      - 'wallet'
      - 'airdrop'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: parent_archive and child_scripthost and (selection_lnk or selection_remote_fetch or selection_lure) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT-distributed MSI installers launched from a network share
  - Software vendors who ship products inside ISO containers
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\7zG.exe OR *\7zg.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\7zfm.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\winrar.exe OR *\Bandizip.exe OR *\bandizip.exe) @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\Cmd.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\MsiExec.exe OR *\Curl.exe) (@CommandLine:(*.lnk* OR *.LNK*) OR @CommandLine:(*http\://* OR *https\://* OR *msiexec\ \/i\ http* OR *certutil\ -urlcache* OR *bitsadmin\ \/transfer* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *DownloadString* OR *IEX*) OR @CommandLine:(*jobdescription* OR *JobDescription* OR *compensation* OR *recruit* OR *Recruit* OR *whitepaper* OR *kucoin* OR *binance* OR *Coinbase* OR *coinbase* OR *wallet* OR *Wallet* OR *airdrop*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(explorer|7zG|7zFM|WinRAR|Bandizip)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|msiexec|curl)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| LnkLaunch := if(regex("(?i)\\.lnk", field=CommandLine), "1", "0")
| RemoteFetch := if(regex("(?i)(https?://|msiexec\\s+/(i|q|quiet)\\s+http|curl\\s+(-o|--output|-s)\\s+http|certutil\\s+-(urlcache|decode)|bitsadmin\\s+/transfer|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|\\bIEX\\b|rundll32\\s+[^,]+,#?\\d+)", field=CommandLine), "1", "0")
| LureHit := if(regex("(?i)(jobdescription|compensation|offer_letter|recruit|whitepaper|kucoin|binance|coinbase|wallet|airdrop|crypto|trading|investor|web3|defi|nft)", field=CommandLine), "1", "0")
| MountedFromRemovable := if(regex("^[D-Z]:\\\\", field=ImageFileName), "1", "0")
| (MountedFromRemovable="1" AND (RemoteFetch="1" OR LnkLaunch="1")) OR (LnkLaunch="1" AND RemoteFetch="1") OR (LureHit="1" AND (RemoteFetch="1" OR LnkLaunch="1"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp)])
ucs.rationale: Bluenoroff/Sapphire Sleet/TA444's signature 2023-2026 initial-access pattern is a recruiter or investor lure delivering an ISO/IMG/ZIP archive that mounts as a separate drive letter and hosts a LNK whose target launches a script-host or msiexec/curl process that pulls down KANDYKORN/RustBucket/CageyChameleon/ObjCShellz second-stages. Pairing the archive-or-Explorer-mounted parent with a LOLBin chi

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff AppleJeus / TraderTraitor trojanised trading-app service persistence + DNS beacon
ucs.description: Hunts the Bluenoroff/APT38 AppleJeus / TraderTraitor / SnatchCrypto persistence pattern - a recently-installed signed-looking 'trading' or 'wallet' app drops a payload into ProgramData / AppData, registers a Windows service whose binary lives outside system32, and then beacons out to a low-prevalence HTTPS / DNS endpoint within minutes of install.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstSeen FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Registry WHERE (Registry.registry_path LIKE "HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%" AND Registry.registry_value_name="ImagePath") AND (Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%\\ProgramData\\%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%\\AppData\\%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%\\Public\\%" OR Registry.registry_value_data LIKE "%\\Users\\%") AND match(Registry.registry_value_data,"(?i)(trader|trading|crypto|wallet|airdrop|kucoin|celas|wizairdrop|jmtt|cryptoneuro|union\s?crypto|kupay|dafom|cryptoaisignal|bloxholder|tokenaiz|trade|edu\-?defi|chainalysis|ledger)") by Registry.dest Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_data | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | rename dest as svc_host | join type=inner svc_host [| tstats summariesonly=true count FROM datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic WHERE All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,80,8443,53) AND All_Traffic.app != "unknown" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename src as svc_host] | where firstSeen > relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | table firstSeen svc_host registry_value_data dest dest_port app
ucs.kql:
let TraderLure = @"(?i)(trader|trading|crypto|wallet|airdrop|kucoin|celas|wizairdrop|jmtt|cryptoneuro|union\s?crypto|kupay|dafom|cryptoaisignal|bloxholder|tokenaiz|edu-?defi|chainalysis|ledger|tradertraitor)";
let SvcWrites = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where RegistryKey startswith @"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)\\(ProgramData|AppData|Users\\Public|Users\\[^\\]+\\AppData)\\"
    | where RegistryValueData matches regex TraderLure
    | project SvcWriteTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, RegistryKey, ServiceImagePath = RegistryValueData,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256;
let SvcExe = SvcWrites | extend SvcExeName = tolower(tostring(split(extract(@"([^\\\"]+\.exe)",1,ServiceImagePath),"\\")[-1]));
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("services.exe","svchost.exe") or InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(ProgramData|AppData|Users\\Public)\\"
| extend ChildName = tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName)
| join kind=inner (SvcExe) on $left.DeviceId == $right.DeviceId, $left.ChildName == $right.SvcExeName
| where Timestamp between (SvcWriteTime .. SvcWriteTime + 24h)
| summarize FirstBeacon = min(Timestamp), Beacons = count(), Destinations = make_set(RemoteUrl,10), IPs = make_set(RemoteIP,10)
          by DeviceName, ServiceImagePath, ChildName, SvcWriteTime
| where Beacons >= 2
| order by FirstBeacon desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let TraderLure = @"(?i)(trader|trading|crypto|wallet|airdrop|kucoin|celas|wizairdrop|jmtt|cryptoneuro|union\s?crypto|kupay|dafom|cryptoaisignal|bloxholder|tokenaiz|edu-?defi|chainalysis|ledger|tradertraitor)";
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 7045
| extend SvcImagePath = tostring(extract(@"(?i)Service File Name:\s+([^\r\n]+)",1,EventData)),
         SvcName     = tostring(extract(@"(?i)Service Name:\s+([^\r\n]+)",1,EventData))
| where SvcImagePath matches regex @"(?i)\\(ProgramData|AppData|Users\\Public|Users\\[^\\]+\\AppData)\\"
| where SvcImagePath matches regex TraderLure
| project SvcWriteTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcName, SvcImagePath
| join kind=inner (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where DstPortNumber in (80,443,8443,53)
    | where NetworkDirection == "Outbound"
) on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (SvcWriteTime .. SvcWriteTime + 24h)
| summarize FirstBeacon = min(TimeGenerated), Beacons = count(), Dsts = make_set(DstHostname,10), IPs = make_set(DstIpAddr,10)
          by Computer, SvcName, SvcImagePath, SvcWriteTime
| where Beacons >= 2
| order by FirstBeacon desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\*\ImagePath OR *\system\currentcontrolset\services\*\imagepath OR *\SYSTEM\CURRENTCONTROLSET\SERVICES\*\IMAGEPATH) @Details:(*\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\AppData\* OR *\appdata\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\users\public\*) @Details:(*trader* OR *Trader* OR *trading* OR *Trading* OR *crypto* OR *Crypto* OR *wallet* OR *Wallet* OR *kucoin* OR *KuCoin* OR *celas* OR *Celas* OR *WizAirDrop* OR *wizairdrop* OR *CryptoNeuro* OR *AlticGo* OR *Kupay* OR *Dafom* OR *CryptoAISignal* OR *TraderTraitor* OR *Ledger*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| RegObjectName=/(?i)\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\[^\\]+$/
| RegValueName=/(?i)^ImagePath$/
| regex("(?i)\\\\(ProgramData|AppData|Users\\\\Public|Users\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\AppData)\\\\", field=RegStringValue)
| regex("(?i)(trader|trading|crypto|wallet|airdrop|kucoin|celas|wizairdrop|jmtt|cryptoneuro|union\\s?crypto|kupay|dafom|cryptoaisignal|bloxholder|tokenaiz|chainalysis|ledger|tradertraitor)", field=RegStringValue)
| SvcExe := regex("(?i)([^\\\\\"]+\\.exe)", field=RegStringValue, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, RegObjectName, RegStringValue, SvcExe], function=[count(), min(@timestamp) as FirstSeen])
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest OR #event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 | ContextImageFileName=/(?i)\\(ProgramData|AppData|Users\\\\Public)\\\\.*\\.exe$/ | groupBy([aid, ContextImageFileName], function=[count() as Beacons, collect([DomainName, RemoteAddressIP4], limit=10)])}, field=aid)
| Beacons > 1
ucs.rationale: AppleJeus (Celas Trade Pro, JMT Trading, WizAirDrop, Union Crypto, Kupay, Dafom, CryptoAISignal, Bloxholder) and the 2022-2026 TraderTraitor variants are Bluenoroff's signature persistence pattern: a 'trading' or 'wallet' MSI registers a Windows service from a user-writable directory and then beacons C2 within minutes. CISA AA22-108A / AA22-187A and Mandiant TEMP.Hermit reporting all describe this

_field_issues.message: `Public` is not a canonical column of DeviceRegistryEvents.
`ProgramData` is not a canonical column of DeviceRegistryEvents.
`AppData` is not a canonical column of DeviceRegistryEvents.
`Users` is not a canonical column of DeviceRegistryEvents.
`RemoteUrl` is not a column of DeviceRegistryEvents; it does exist on DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceEvents, AlertEvidence, ASCDeviceEvents.
`RemoteIP` is not a column of DeviceRegistryEvents; it does exist on DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceLogonEvents, DeviceEvents, AlertEvidence, ASCDeviceEvents.
